results.title: Colts GM Chris Ballard sends strong message amid Keenan Allen’s arrest
results.description: Indianapolis Colts general manager Chris Ballard appears to be a big believer in second chances. The Colts granted Keenan Allen such a chance when the team decided not to cut the veteran wide receiver after he was arrested over two misdemeanor drunken-driving charges.

results.title: Orlando Pirates must address defensive and midfield vulnerabilities despite impressive start,
results.description: Orlando Pirates are enjoying a strong season, but coach Abdeslam Ouaddou must address defensive vulnerabilities and midfield cohesion to maintain their impressive early title momentum.
